meta.name: pirates_vs_unicorns
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

programs.brief: A towering white quartz and gold statue of a rearing celestial unicorn guardian standing at the cliff edge overlooking the strait, facing the enemy shore.
A heavily fortified coastal timber-and-darkstone redoubt with iron cannon ports and a tattered skull banner, aiming directly across the strait.
A fortified shoreline gun battery with dark iron cannons mounted behind timber sandbag emplacements pointing across the strait.
A glowing amethyst and quartz crystal spire tethered by golden runic chains, providing magical warding along the coast.

tokens.terrain: two distinct islands separated by open water and facing each other across a strait
tokens.event_direction: the pirate batteries and the unicorn bastion squaring off across the water
tokens.infra: cannon_battery along the pirate shore facing the strait; watch_towers and sea defenses along the unicorn coast
tokens.region_pirate_island: era renaissance, wealth 0.3, decline 0.5, formality 0.15; materialTheme temperate_timber; formPacks [nautical_pirate]; prefer archetypes tavern, warehouse, watchtower, lighthouse; props galleon, cart; careened hulls, shore batteries, smuggler docks, fortified cliff redoubts
tokens.region_unicorn_island: era medieval, wealth 0.85, decline 0.05, formality 0.75; materialTheme white_quartz; formPacks [arcane_magical]; prefer archetypes church, manor, watchtower, peripteral_temple; white stone ramparts, sacred meadows, rune circles, enchanted unicorn groves, battle towers
